notes.title: Tattoo Punk - Irezumi News: Macbeth Night 50th anniversary
notes.content:
Thursday, May 18, marks the 50th anniversary of the corporate scandal in Irezumi City, the Macbeth Night.


Younger readers might not remember this, so it's time for a history lesson.

[b]What is Macbeth Night? [/b]

In 2050, Banco’s supervisory board tried to take over Nestor Company to increase their impacts and redeem eXXXperience and Shigeru to take control of the city on their own. The conspiracy was discovered. [b]Exactly on the night of May 18-19, 2050 ther was, so called, Macbeth Night.[/b] 

Technically all members of the supervisory board of the Banco’s were murdered by the Shibings (hired by Shigeru company). Banco Company was aggressively restructured and command was assumed by Shigeru, eXXXperience and Nestor directors. Banco was no longer a member of the Great Four.

Over the next few years, Banco was a shadow of its former self. Until 2055, when Bahni Kaur took up the position of CEO and inaugurated heavy-handedness methods. Bahni allocated funds in Shibing’s army and took aggressive steps to eliminate the competition. Her actions displeased other boards, but their corporations were committed to conflict between the United States of West America. 

Around this time, has grown exponentially, a new finance corporation - Préstamo Migayo. Frictions between both companies were rising, so soon from either side started gaining allies, improving the impact and recruiting Shibings. 

[b]This led to the Chaotic War in 2073. [/b]

As a result of the war, Banco regained its position in the Great Four.

notes.title: Tattoo Punk - Irezumi News: Few victims of the shootout in the center of Irezumi
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40474865/7ef715f970089f23dcc8e356784a7108d0dadd19.png[/img]

On Wednesday afternoon [b]Irezumi streets devolved into chaos when gunfire erupted[/b], killing at least five people and wounding a dozen more. This is not the first time that we have had a problem relating to safety in our town. Acts of sabotage and provocations become more and more frequent.


It's not clear how many victims in total were taken from the scene to area hospitals. 

"At this time, at least five people have lost their lives, among numerous other shooting victims, including several with life-threatening injuries. We hold those who have died, and their families, in our prayers today, and we also pray for the recoveries of those injured," a police spokesman said to KN.

The police are yet to confirm that the riots are the result of clashes between two corporations Blake Blake & Blake and Nestor. Both refused to comment.
[b]Nonetheless, no one was arrested and charged. 
[/b]

Public opinion puts into question police actions. 
No wonder that [b]Valia Juska has already arrived at the scene of the incident[/b]. Is her presence a foreshadow of finding circumstantial evidence? Or an attempt to improve the image of the Police Department? 
“I’m going to solve this at all costs and make sure that the victims' families will have clarity on who precisely caused the deaths of their loved ones,” she said.
For those who have not heard of her yet, Valia is considered as the hard case detective and famous for her determination in striving for justice. More about her you will find out in our After News Daily.

notes.title: Tattoo Punk - Announcement Trailer 2021
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=lJPHAPq63gU;full][/previewyoutube]

Tattoo Punk is a story driven, management game where you own the Cyber - Tattoo Studio. You play as Henry, newly single father trying to create the best Tattoo place in the overwhelmed mafia scores city. Customize your studio, make dope futuristic tats, grow your business and brand. Create your own story in the spoiled city of body modifications, cash and fame. Soak into the Tattoo Punk world. 

💸 JOIN OFFICIAL DISCORD: https://discord.gg/prZta8qVPJ
💸 ADD TO WISHLIST: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1594850/Tattoo_Punk/

Those concrete blocks, kitschy neons and pervasive stench of garbage are my city. This is where I grew up and where I'll die sooner or later. I suppose death is always with us - taking away a beloved one, leaving with pain and regret. We are used to it here. They say you have to seize the day, but they know nothing about you. See, when I was a kid I wanted to create art, like my Father. Big name, big cheese, a true scum like no other. Since he dumped his own family, I had to help my mother. It was a bit of a rough start, but I was getting the hang of this job. Neon graffiti for 5 bucks, a tattoo for 20. Crazy stuff, you know? Years passed. I raised a family, saved some money. And suddenly something must have gone wrong. They took her away from me. Here I am standing in my first tattoo studio, trying to make a living for our son and not let her down. 

Anyway, long story short, welcome to my world, dude. Tattoo Punk world.
